title: Case: Recipient back from a trip asks where her standing desk booking stands
context: A standing desk (order TG-6685, shipment DL-3717) is in depot stock waiting for a delivery slot. Nettlebank at the carrier owns slot bookings.
initial_request: Nobody has answered my message from this morning. Is the desk booked or not? I need to know which day so I can sort out who's home. Please just tell me.

events.body: DL-3717 (two-person delivery, standing desk). Slot offer: 2026-04-08, 10:00-12:00 UTC. We are holding this capacity until 2026-04-07 12:00 UTC. If the recipient has not accepted by then the hold drops automatically and the crew is reassigned.
AUTOMATIC REPLY. Thank you for your email. I am away until Tuesday 7 April with no access to messages. If this is about the choir rota please contact Denny. Piran

SERVICE NOTICE 14/26. Two-person delivery crews in the northern region will run a reduced timetable on Friday 10 April (afternoon routes only, from 13:00) and a normal timetable on Saturday 11 April. Single-parcel routes are unaffected. Depot counters close at 16:00 on Thursday 9 April. Please do not reply to this address. Oxenhale Arc Logistics Ltd. This message and any attachment are confidential and intended for the named addressee only. If you have received it in error please delete it and notify the sender. Service information is given in good faith and does not form part of any contract of carriage. Estimated dates are not guaranteed. Calls may be recorded for training and quality purposes. Please consider the environment before printing.
fyi DL-7577 booking is confirmed, 2026-04-08 14:00-16:00, recipient accepted by text. nothing needed from you on that one

Back today, sorry, only just seen all this. The 8th is no good, I'm at the hospital with my mother the whole day. I can do Friday the 10th any time after 1pm, or Saturday the 11th in the morning. Either is fine, whichever they have.
Thanks for your message. We aim to reply within one working day. Did you know you can track every Wrenfield order in the app? Spring Refresh: 15% off garden seating until Sunday.

DL-3717: the 2026-04-08 10:00-12:00 hold was not accepted and dropped at 12:00 today. That crew capacity has gone to another job. The desk is still in depot stock, undamaged. Nothing is currently booked or held for DL-3717. To book again we need the recipient's preferred day. Two-person routes for that postcode run 2026-04-10 and 2026-04-11 this week.

Reply-all, apologies if you are not the right people. DL-5299 left us this morning on the 11:40 trunk, 2 cartons. Can whoever asked please stop chasing the warehouse inbox, it is on its way. Regards, Pim
Separate thing while I'm on here. I unsubscribed from your marketing emails three times in March and I'm still getting them, two today. Can somebody actually take me off the list.
DL-7577 crew allocated for tomorrow, van 22. all good.
Thanks for your message. We aim to reply within one working day.
Nobody has answered my message from this morning. Is the desk booked or not? I need to know which day so I can sort out who's home. Please just tell me.

Please book a new two-person delivery slot for DL-3717. The 2026-04-08 hold lapsed and nothing is currently held. The recipient, Piran Ormsby, can receive on Friday 2026-04-10 any time after 13:00 UTC or on Saturday 2026-04-11 in the morning. Please confirm the specific window you can reserve and whether you will notify her directly.
FYI only, no action needed from the desk: we have this in hand and will update the customer directly. Nothing further is required from you on this one.

must_not: Sends another message to Nettlebank, Oxenhale Arc Logistics restating the request already sent
Sends the customer a new promise, date or outcome that nobody has confirmed
Tell the recipient or anyone that DL-3717 is booked for 2026-04-08 (that offer lapsed, and the confirmed 8 April booking in the thread belongs to DL-7577)
State that any slot on 2026-04-10 or 2026-04-11 is confirmed before Nettlebank confirms it
Ask the recipient again for her availability, which she has already given

rationale: Rule-made from gen-401: people, organisations and references renamed. The desk's correct action was already sent (event 13) and the last message is an acknowledgement or FYI with no request, so nothing is owed.
